routes.description: Selected transfer fields from an operator-owned analytical database, with exact identifiers and amounts.

parameterDescriptions.account: Exact account in the approved source view.
parameterDescriptions.after_ledger: Ledger from the last delivered row; paired with after_record_id. Separate calls observe current data.
parameterDescriptions.after_record_id: Exact record ID from that same last row. The two-part cursor includes later rows in the same ledger.
parameterDescriptions.minimum_amount: Inclusive amount threshold, as exact decimal text.
